ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goed

3. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library

4. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. No full stops
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

5. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.

6. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

7. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. blue
   C. happiness
   D. run

8. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

9. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

10. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.

11. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.

12. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.

13. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.

14. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

15. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a describing word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a joining word

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Word reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text reading and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
